annotations.title: Where a rail's published price sits

description: Keyed. For one corridor, the rail's own published rate beside the official rate and a public market read when one exists. Position is lower_landed_cost, higher_landed_cost or unknown. A missing figure is Being measured.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency (what leaves), e.g. 'ZAR'.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the destination currency (what lands), e.g. 'USD'.
